services.desc: Enjoy a MILWAUKEE DAY SAIL aboard Red Witch II, a traditional sailboat. Please note that one of the former boats in our fleet, "Tall Ship" Red Witch, was voted "Best Tour and Charter Boat" in Chicago in 2009, 2010 and 2012 (3rd overall) by prestigious IlinoisMeetings+Events. See our reviews -- this is truly a memorable experience on a magnificent sailboat with a seasoned, informative captain and friendly crew. Duration 90 Minutes About The Sailing Experience We really do sail – once outside the harbor we hoist the sails, turn off the engine, and experience the magnificence of pure sailing on Lake Michigan. IF YOU DON'T SEE A TIME SLOT YOU PREFER, CALL US AT 312.469.0233. IF YOU PREFER A PRIVATE EVENT FOR MORE THAN 6 GUESTS, WE CAN ACCOMMODATE UP TO 28 GUESTS ON RED WITCH II (IN MILWAUKEE'S BEAUTIFUL THIRD WARD). Red Witch III is an exceptionally seaworthy, comfortable, fast and fun 6-passenger sailboat! Red Witch III is an "Islander 36" -- her sisterships routinely sail from LA to Honolulu, Hawai'i and two of her sisterships circumnavigated the globe.
